# Assets

Static files the site serves as-is.

## What's here

- `fonts/`: self-hosted web fonts
- `icons/`, `images/`, `svg/`, `tiles/`: graphics
- `storyboards/`: exported storyboard SVGs
- `js/`: the built animation bundle (git-ignored, made by `npm run build:js`)
